events.title: Demo Update 0.9.5
events.summary: Thanks for all the reports. The one we heard most was that the Bacteria shows up too often. This update is mostly about that.The Bacteria does not show up as often. f it loses track of you and you never actually see it, it tries one more time and then goes quiet for a good while. Before this, it could keep coming back every minute or so. That was a bug, not the plan.Scares are spaced out more. events.title: Free Demo Out Now!
events.summary: The free demo of The Backrooms: Threshold is live on Steam.Open the portal and step into Level 0 with nothing but a camcorder and a Dowser. Every trip through the portal generates a new stretch of the Backrooms, so no two expeditions are the same. Your job: bring back footageFind and film proof of what is down there:- Signs of life- Anomalous rooms- No-clipped objectsWhen you have what you came for, use the Dowser to find your way back to the lab.
